title: Chapter 6473: Want To Become An Immortal?

Chapter 6473: Want To Become An Immortal?

Chapter 6473: Want To Become An Immortal?

Eight-armed Immortal Child relied on his cultivation and firm dao heart to endure this ultimate force. His three thousand worlds became resplendent with an immortal light.

“Three thousand worlds to one!” He shouted.

The worlds behind him melted and their powers flowed into him. The rays emanating from his new form illuminated Sea of Heavenly Sin.

“Boom!” Everything suddenly converged together into a blinding eruption.

Once it died down, the immortal child appeared again. He gave a feeling of metamorphosis - a glimpse into immortality due to the new energy floating behind him.

Alch-deer and Ocean-gaze shuddered because the opponent had immortal energy now. Thus, they were mere mortals despite their cultivation prowess.

“Different from our Gold Village.” Luosha said.

The village required gold while Paragon demanded kingdom-building and a will to endure the blessing from the lord. The immortal child appeared more powerful than Skyraiser Ancestor.

It seemed that the blessing varied in both form and power.

“Where does this power come from?” Virtuoso became curious.

Gold Village’s fuel originated from the Spring of Splendor. Alch-deer used the power of gold to augment his fortunes and dao. After leaving this dream, he might become a twelve-fruit emperor.

On the other hand, the final powers given to Skyraiser and the immortal child still belonged to the lord. This meant it could always be taken back.

Alch-deer and the others wondered what these two wanted from this temporary boost.

“Immortal? Looks like your comprehension of this level is rather shallow.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Brat, don’t be lecturing me.” The lord's voice answered instead, clearly annoyed: “Defeat him and this power will be yours forever.”

“Forever then!” The immortal child summoned flames but instead of burning Li Qiye, he chose to burn himself.

“What’s going on?” This confused everyone.

“He’s burning his true blood, no holding back.” Ocean-gaze explained.

Although the immortal child was a vessel, he couldn’t truly exert this power. Therefore, he burned his true blood to improve his chance at winning and keeping the power.

“Buzz.” Once the flames came together, he finally made his move.

“Eternal immortal.” He murmured and drew with his finger, turning the world into an immortal world and adding immortal laws to it.

“Boom!” The immortal laws flew toward Li Qiye. Nothing could withstand its touch so they were reduced to nothingness. The toughest metal or immemorial dao still went down all the same.

“This looks bad!” Ocean-gaze and the others became startled.

Gold Village might not be able to survive. Its golden power would disintegrate as well.

“Want to become an immortal? Observe the beginning first before seeking immortality.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

He raised his hands and opened a greater world. A crow flew out and spread its wings, overshadowing anything the immortal child had to offer.
